rules: This is a fictional deterministic model, not current tax law or investment advice. Money is integer cents.
Project 1 to 60 years (default CLI example: 30). Year 1 uses annual_spending_cents; later spending increases by inflation_bps, rounded to cents.
At the start of each year apply each account annual return to its opening balance, rounding the signed gain to nearest cent, ties away from zero.
Pension income is taxable and starts in income_start_year. There is no other income or tax deduction.
Tax brackets list cumulative upper_cents and rate_bps, with upper_cents=0 for the final unlimited bracket. Compute total progressive tax exactly, then round once to cents, ties up.
First withdraw the required minimum from tax_deferred: post-growth balance times minimum_deferred_bps, rounded to cents.
To cover spending plus tax, use cash first, then additional tax_deferred, then tax_free. At each step withdraw the smallest whole-cent amount sufficient, or exhaust the account.
Cash and tax_free withdrawals are untaxed. All tax_deferred withdrawals are taxable. Recompute tax as withdrawals increase.
Any surplus after spending and tax is deposited into cash at year end. On failure, report the shortfall and stop at that year. first_shortfall_year=0 means no failure in the requested horizon.
